$comment: Confidence levels and source references. A food carries `confidence` (high|medium|low) and `source` (one of the source codes). Confidence should be consistent with the source: government/published databases => high; recipe analysis => medium; community/user estimates => low.

confidenceLevels.name: High
confidenceLevels.description: Backed by a government or published nutritional database.

confidenceLevels.name: Medium
confidenceLevels.description: Recipe-based estimate computed from ingredient nutrition.

confidenceLevels.name: Low
confidenceLevels.description: Community or user-provided estimate, not independently verified.

sources.name: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
